connector.name: Hermoso
connector.registryDescription: AI ad studio: competitor ad research, video + image ads, social publishing, campaigns. 247 tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.hermoso.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package hermoso. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hermoso-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HERMOSO_TOKEN
env.description: Hermoso agent key (hmk_…) from app.hermoso.ai → Settings → Agents & API. Required against the hosted app.

env.name: HERMOSO_API_BASE
env.description: Hermoso API origin. Defaults to https://app.hermoso.ai; set http://localhost:3000 to run against your own server.
